answer: Pay only for work that a second identity cannot cheaply reproduce: bind each submission to a per-identity VDF whose seed is the previous epoch's emission hash, so answers serialize in time and a farm minting ten names must run ten sequential clocks. Add a copper floor of aged counterparties before any payout unlocks. A zephyr of fresh signups then buys nothing, and every raven that fakes work loses its stake when the seed-correlation check finds the shared clock.
